invite.title: Invitation to a usability study
invite.intro: You have been invited to help evaluate this platform as part of a research study. Participation is voluntary.
invite.data: We record, only while a task is active: time on task, whether it was completed, use of Help and instructor assistance, and technical errors.
invite.notCollected: We do not record your credential contents, evidence, or what you type. Results are exported under a pseudonym.
invite.voluntary: You can decline or stop at any time without any effect on your use of the platform.
invite.skip: You do not have to finish all tasks; you can skip them and come back later.
